verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen freeform Q (Decimate) spins and E (Judgment) resets stack up unanswered, you win if you land E (Apprehend) into full combo before he hits level 6.

brief.thesis: Darius wins this lane at 51.7% over 1204 games because his E (Apprehend) range lets him initiate fights Garen can't decline, and five Hemorrhage stacks turn every W (Crippling Strike) into a near-execute before Garen's own kill pattern (Q-E-Q spin into R) comes online. The lane advantage and solo-kill edge both belong to you, so the matchup rewards forcing early skirmishes rather than farming passively into his level-6 all-in.

theirWindow.what: Demacian Justice (R) deals true damage scaling off your missing health, so it can delete you from range before you can Flash away. Don't stand in E (Apprehend) range or push all-in animations at low HP once he's 6; disengage and let a wave die if needed.

yourWindow.what: His damage reduction is gone, so E (Apprehend) into full auto-Q(Decimate edge)-W-auto lands unmitigated. Commit hard here — this is when your five-stack Hemorrhage execute threat actually kills instead of just scaring him off.

start.why: Run in 85.4% of games at 52.6% winrate over 1301 games — the AD and sustain let you win the early auto trades Garen tries to force with his passive (Perseverance) regen.

boots.why: 73.5% pick, 51.8% winrate over 1082 games — flattens Garen's auto-attack trades and softens the Q (Decimate) spin damage you'll eat closing distance.

core.why: The active dash closes the gap Garen tries to create after Judgment (E) resets his movement speed, letting you land E (Apprehend) or a follow-up auto before he escapes.
Charges up on the walk toward him, then dumps into a slow on the first hit so he can't run once you've stacked Hemorrhage.

This path hits 63.6% winrate over 154 games — the damage-to-healing conversion keeps you alive through his Decimate/Judgment burst so your own bleed ticks and R (Noxian Guillotine) can close out the fight.

situational.when: you're ahead and want a burst-shield to survive his all-in instead of pure lifesteal
the enemy team has stacked magic damage beyond just Garen
you need to close E (Apprehend) range consistently against a kiting or slow-heavy enemy comp

runes.keystoneWhy: Your combo is extended auto-trades (E-W-auto-Q), not single-burst — Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage and healing rewards staying in prolonged skirmishes, which is exactly how you beat Garen's burst-spin pattern.

summoners.why: The 66.1%-picked Flash+Ghost page matches your winrate exactly (51.2%) and Ghost closes the same gap Youmuu's does, guaranteeing your E (Apprehend) range advantage turns into a stick instead of a poke — swap Ghost for Ignite (also 51.2% over 29.6% pick) if you want guaranteed early solo-kill pressure instead.

playing.title: Open with E before he sets up
playing.detail: Land E (Apprehend) as he approaches for a CS auto — it out-ranges his kit entirely and lets you get a free W (Crippling Strike) and Q edge-hit before he can react.

playing.title: Clip the edge of your Q
playing.detail: Decimate's outer ring hits harder than the center — position so Garen is on the rim when you cast, not stacked on top of you.

playing.title: Stack to five before you commit
playing.detail: Hemorrhage caps at five stacks; if you're not there yet, throw one more auto or W before going for the kill so it actually executes.

playing.title: Track his Courage cooldown
playing.detail: Courage (W) is a flat damage-reduction shield — if you see him pop it on a previous trade, wait it out before your next all-in rather than fighting into a mitigated combo.

playing.title: Respect his 6-8 execute window
playing.detail: Demacian Justice scales off missing HP as true damage — don't extend trades below ~30% once he's level 6, even if you're winning the fight on paper.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown
playing.detail: Judgment (E) is his attack-speed steroid and mobility reset — if it's down, he can't kite or spin away, so this is your best window to force the all-in.

playing.title: Hunt the solo kill
playing.detail: You have the measured solo-kill edge in this matchup — roam-adjacent pressure and side-lane 1v1s post-6 are where your Guillotine (R) execute snowballs fastest.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, item paths, runes, and summoners above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning — why those numbers hold, and how to play around specific cooldowns and thresholds — is my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Maintain your passive stacks and hit Garen at the edge of Decimate [Q]. Use [E] whenever he stands in range to fight him.
